title: Traffic lights and staying safe
examples: Teacher, when is it okay to cross the road?
What does the yellow light mean for cars?
Can we cross when the light is red?

explain.say: Look at the traffic light. It has three colours: red, amber and green.
Red means stop. Wait at the kerb.

items: Wait for the light to change

explain.say: Amber means the light is about to change. Cars get ready to stop.
The green person means you can cross. Look and listen as you cross.
When the person is red, wait until it turns green.
Before you cross, always look both ways. Hold a grown-up's hand.

faq.q: What does the red light mean?
faq.a: The red light means everyone must stop and wait for the signal to change.
asks: Can we cross when it is red?
What do we do at a red light?

faq.q: What is the amber light for?
faq.a: The amber light tells us that the light is about to change soon.

faq.q: When can we cross the street?
faq.a: At traffic lights, cross when the green person shows. Look both ways first.
asks: What does the green man mean?
Is it always safe to cross?

faq.q: Do we always look both ways?
faq.a: Yes. Even when the light is green, look both ways before you cross.

faq.q: What if the light is broken?
faq.a: If the lights are not working, wait with your grown-up. Find another safe place to cross.
asks: Who do we listen to if the light is out?
What if the traffic light is not working?

facts: Red lights mean stop for everyone.
Amber lights mean be ready to stop.
Green walking people mean it is safe to cross.
We must always look both ways before crossing.

quiz.say: The light shows a red person. What do you do?
quiz.why: A red person means wait. Stay at the kerb.

wrong.1: Walk only when the green person shows.
wrong.2: Running across is unsafe, so wait for the green person.

quiz.say: The light for cars turns amber. What does amber tell drivers?
quiz.why: Amber comes before red. Drivers get ready to stop.

wrong.0: Amber warns drivers that red is coming next.
wrong.2: A closed road has signs or barriers, and amber is about stopping.

quiz.say: The green person shows. What do you still do before you cross?
quiz.why: A car might be late to stop. Looking both ways keeps you safe.

wrong.0: A car might still be coming, so look first.
wrong.1: Running can make you trip, so walk across.
